description: This file defines the BuzzLikeDao class responsible for data access operations related to 'like' entities on shares and comments within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It includes methods for saving, deleting, retrieving, and counting likes, along with internal query builder methods that support filtering and pagination.

classes.name: BuzzLikeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling CRUD operations and complex queries related to BuzzLike entities on shares and comments within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin.

methods.name: saveBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLikeOnShare entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: saveBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLikeOnComment entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: deleteBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Deletes a like on a share based on share ID and employee number.

methods.name: deleteBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Deletes a like on a comment based on comment ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnShare entity based on share ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnComment entity based on comment ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzLikeOnShare entities matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareCount
methods.description: Returns the count of BuzzLikeOnShare entities matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzLikeOnComment entities matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentCount
methods.description: Returns the count of BuzzLikeOnComment entities matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper for BuzzLikeOnShare entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper for BuzzLikeOnComment entities based on filter parameters.
